articles.summary: Vote.org CEO Andrea Hailey was a guest on this week's episode of The Downballot podcast, hosted by David Nir and David Beard. The conversation centered on the escalating attacks on voting rights, states that are leading the way on voter access and registration, and how Vote.org has grown into the largest organization in the country dedicated to boosting voter participation.
articles.title: ICYMI: Vote.org CEO Featured on The Downballot Podcast
